description: Specs of the main suite that must pass against the Go preview (M1), run with the e2e build. Each excluded test names the capability outside M1 it depends on. run-go-subset.js turns this file into a Playwright invocation.

requires.passkeys: passkeys (D1, internal/auth/webauthn); in the build since the third wave
requires.e2e_hooks: the realtime shim maps the e2e_* hooks to the e2e. routes of the e2e build (D4); in the build since the third wave
